meta.dataNote: Project data is updated from KDP, Amazon Ads, Goodreads, and campaign screenshots supplied by Chris. It is not a live Amazon API feed.

mission.title: Put the memoir in front of readers who do not already know Chris
mission.summary: The first controlled cold-reader test is scheduled: a 99¢ Kindle Countdown Deal supported by a seven-day Sponsored Products campaign. The goal is not instant fame. The goal is clean evidence—impressions, clicks, purchases, pages read, and lessons we can use for the next campaign.
mission.nextCheckpoint: Verify the 99¢ Kindle price and first ad impressions on July 28.

reviewGoal.label: Amazon review milestone
reviewGoal.note: Twenty reviews is a credibility goal—not a documented Amazon algorithm switch.

campaign.name: LLMC - Kindle Countdown - Auto - Jul 2026
campaign.objective: Measure whether unfamiliar Amazon shoppers will see, click, buy, borrow, or begin reading the memoir when the offer is strong.

goodreads.problem: The memoir is incorrectly grouped with two unrelated R.C. Howard books, producing a misleading 2.33 author average.
goodreads.action: A profile-separation request was submitted. Do not claim the mixed profile until a librarian moves the memoir to a clean author page.

now.title: Hold the campaign steady
now.detail: Do not change targeting, bid, budget, or advertised format before the campaign begins unless Amazon reports an error.

now.title: Watch the Goodreads thread
now.detail: Check for a librarian response once daily. No repeated follow-ups yet.

now.title: Regression-test this staging build
now.detail: Open every staging module, compare it with production, and confirm production remains unchanged.

next.title: July 28 price verification
next.detail: Confirm the Kindle listing visibly shows $0.99 before announcing the promotion.

next.title: First campaign telemetry
next.detail: Record impressions, clicks, spend, average CPC, orders, KENP, and budget status after the first full day.

next.title: Amazon storefront audit
next.detail: Review Author Central, linked formats, description, exact-title search, keywords, categories, Read Sample, and A+ Content.

waiting.title: Amazon Ads delivery
waiting.detail: Campaign begins July 28 and ends August 3.

waiting.title: Goodreads author split
waiting.detail: Waiting for a volunteer librarian to separate the unrelated author records.

milestones.title: Sponsored Products campaign launched
milestones.detail: $0.35 default bid, $5 average daily budget, automatic targeting, Kindle only.

milestones.title: Goodreads correction request submitted
milestones.detail: Requested a separate R.C. Howard author profile for the memoir and its three editions.

milestones.title: Kindle Countdown Deal scheduled
milestones.detail: 99¢ from July 28 at 8:00 AM PDT through August 4 at 8:00 AM PDT.

milestones.title: Lifetime baseline confirmed
milestones.detail: 43 total units: 6 Kindle, 22 paperback, 15 hardcover; 66 KENP.

milestones.title: Safe deployment pipeline established
milestones.detail: Production backup, codex-staging branch, and automatic public-by-link staging preview created.

captainsLog.entry: Launched the first paid campaign after establishing billing, automatic targeting, a $0.35 down-only bid, and a $5 average daily budget.
Discovered the Goodreads author collision and submitted a formal librarian correction request before promoting the profile.
Replaced the old local-only staging dependency with a GitHub-based review pipeline. Production remains at the permanent URL printed in the book.
